programme.title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders

programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.title: Struggle Meals
programme.desc: Frankie harnesses the power of time to transform simple ingredients into flavorful goods that'll stick around for a long time. Learn the basics of preserving, pickling & curing to make dinner anything but a struggle. It just takes a little patience.

programme.title: Struggle Meals

programme.desc: Jamie cooks a chicken sheet pan dinner with early tomatoes, potatoes and chorizo. Buddy helps pick strawberries for quick jam rice pudding. The summer feast ends with spicy shrimp skewers with homegrown chillies and a refreshing cucumber gazpacho.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons
programme.sub-title: Stuffed Salmon Celebration and Almond Custard Tart
programme.desc: Jamie snazzes up some spuds with wild garlic pesto, creates a broad bean mezze, rustles up a beautiful spring salad and honours rhubarb in a luscious custard tart with almond brittle.

programme.title: Esta historia me suena

programme.title: El Chavo Animado
programme.desc: La vecindad se prepara para la Navidad, y por la noche, todos los niños hacen sus cartas para Santa Claus, únicamente el Chavo se queda dormido sin poder mandar su carta, pero por la mañana recibe una gran sorpresa.

programme.title: El Chavo Animado
programme.desc: El Chavo y Quico buscan al hombre invisible y creen que don Ramón es su amigo. Don Ramón les dice que tiene la receta para volverse invisible, pero ellos sospechan que la verdadera fórmula es la pintura de don Ramón.

programme.title: Vecinos
programme.desc: Arturo llega con la noticia de que Alejandra será una nueva empleada en la empresa donde trabaja. Por otro lado, una pequeña apuesta entre Germán y Birote crece sin control.

programme.title: Vecinos
programme.desc: Magda tiene una idea al saber que la gente podría comprar las reliquias de su marido y decide realizar una subasta. Sin embargo, Arturo intentará recuperar sus cosas.

programme.title: El Chapulín Colorado
programme.sub-title: Los micrófonos están en la onda fresa
programme.desc: El Chapulín Colorado será invocado para ayudar a una pareja a encontrar micrófonos ocultos en su habitación, ya que tendrán que hablar de algunas cosas muy confidenciales.

programme.title: El Chapulín Colorado
programme.sub-title: No es lo mismo los platillos voladores que los bolillos plateadores
programme.desc: Un marinero ve un platillo volador, pero nadie le cree. Asustado, decide llamar a Chapulín Colorado, que descubre que las cosas podrían ser mucho peores.

programme.title: El Chavo
programme.desc: El Chavo está enamorado de Paty y Quico le hace burla mientras la Chilindrina siente celos. Don Ramón está enamorado de Gloria y hace todo lo posible por invitarla al cine, ya que con tan solo escucharla, se siente en la gloria.

programme.title: La Dueña
programme.desc: Chuy ve a Mauricio besando a Laura. José María le dice a Patricia que no es el padre del hijo de Sonia.

programme.title: La mentira
programme.desc: Verónica intenta que Karla le diga la verdad para ayudarla. Las mujeres que trabajaban con Verónica en la hacienda se hospedan en su casa. El esposo de Irma la extraña y se emborracha, el padre William le lleva comida.

programme.title: Béisbol Central

programme.title: Béisbol MLB

programme.title: Como dice el dicho
programme.sub-title: Antes de que te cases, mira lo que haces
programme.desc: Juanito constantemente ve cómo se pelean sus padres. Su papá trata de manipularlo haciéndole creer que la mala es su mamá, sin confesarle que él la golpea, insulta y le es infiel.

programme.title: Lo tomas o lo dejas
programme.desc: Amine por fin es participante y se emociona al ver que es la elegida para concursar por el premio mayor y hará su mejor esfuerzo para ganar.

programme.title: The Losers
programme.desc: Un grupo de comandos de la CIA es traicionado en una misión secreta en la selva de Bolivia. Sobreviven al ataque y buscan venganza, pero deben apresurarse: Los Ángeles está bajo la amenaza de un arma tecnológica terrorista.

programme.title: C.D.I. Código de investigación

programme.desc: Chipiona, 1954. Rocío, de nueve años, gana un concurso en Sevilla. Quiere ser cantante. Una amiga de la familia convence al abuelo para que la deje ir a Madrid junto a su madre. Concha Piquer la recibe para escucharla cantar, pero no la valora.

programme.title: Colorín Colorado
programme.desc: Un padre está desesperado por la situación de su hija, quien vive con su amante y acaba de tener un hijo.

programme.title: Eloísa está debajo de un almendro
programme.desc: En una lúgubre mansión vive una familia excéntrica que mantiene un oscuro secreto el cual la une a otra extraña familia.

programme.title: Los farsantes
programme.desc: El grupo de teatro de Don Pancho es una compañía de cómicos que deambulan de pueblo en pueblo intentando mantener en pie la compañía, pero los contratos no llegan y malviven con la esperanza de que algún día todo sea distinto.

programme.title: El disputado voto del Sr. Cayo
programme.desc: Un joven activista político encuentra un campesino anticuado que rechaza su modo moderno de vida.

programme.title: El año de las luces
programme.desc: Dos hermanos son internados en un sanatorio, al suponerse enfermos de tuberculosis, el mayor se enreda con la enfermera.

programme.title: El grano de mostaza
programme.desc: A Esperanza le inspira confianza sor Teresa y le cuenta toda su vida, pero, en realidad, sor Teresa no es monja, es una delincuente. Con su cómplice, piensa robarle todo a Esperanza.

programme.title: Guerreros
programme.desc: Un espadachín (Irfan Khan) debe eliminar a los ayudantes de un hombre déspota después de que él renuncia a la violencia y se dirige a los Himalayas.

programme.title: Miss Caribe
programme.desc: Alejandra recibe una extraña herencia tras la muerte de su padre: se convierte en propietaria de un barco que resulta ser un burdel flotante. Poco a poco, las relajadas costumbres del trópico cambiarán la mentalidad de Alejandra.

programme.title: Los hombres siempre mienten
programme.desc: Martín es un estudiante de literatura sin mucho talento y poco agraciado. Para salir del paso con un trabajo de clase se apropia de un capítulo de una novela de un vecino que es un afamado escritor.

programme.title: Cha-Cha-Chá
programme.desc: Dos bonitas amigas lo comparten casi todo, menos el novio de una de ellas, del cual la otra está enamorada.

programme.title: Más allá del jardín
programme.desc: Palmira Gadea, una mujer de la burguesía sevillana, celebra sus veinticinco años de matrimonio y los regalos que recibe son muy especiales: su marido la engaña, su hija está embarazada de un desconocido y su hijo muere en un accidente.

programme.title: Tengo 17 años
programme.desc: Una joven rica, que es huérfana de madre, huye de su casa y se refugia con una familia que se dedica a la alfarería.

programme.title: ¿Qué hace una chica como tú en un sitio como éste?

programme.title: Como alas al viento

programme.title: La dama boba

programme.title: El monosabio
programme.desc: Un torero fracasado organiza una corrida para su yerno, pero este termina actuando como el matador principal.

programme.title: Susana

programme.title: Segunda piel
programme.desc: Elena descubre que su esposo, Alberto, la ha estado engañando, pero no sabe que le ha sido infiel con un hombre.

programme.title: Cosas que hacen que la vida valga la pena

programme.title: Los 33 de Atacama

programme.desc: Alex se encuentra de vacaciones en pareja en Ibiza con su exesposo, su exnovio, sus nuevas novias y Ruari como su acompañante.

programme.title: Rage
programme.desc: Cinco mujeres enfrentan situaciones extremas como la extorsión, la opresión y la manipulación. Sus conflictos se entrelazan, desencadenando un efecto mariposa que finalmente conduce a una catarsis compartida.

programme.title: Mickey 17
programme.desc: A disposable employee is sent on a human expedition to colonize the ice world Niflheim. After one iteration dies, a new body is regenerated with most of his memories intact.

programme.title: The Rover
programme.desc: After thieves steal his car, a hardened loner (Guy Pearce) forces a wounded member (Robert Pattinson) of their gang to help him track them down across a scorched and perilous landscape.

programme.title: The Way, Way Back
programme.desc: After his mother's lover (Steve Carell) belittles him, a boy (Liam James) befriends a water-park employee (Sam Rockwell) who helps give him the confidence to come out of his shell.

programme.title: The Dilemma
programme.desc: As an important presentation nears, a business partner (Vince Vaughn) agonizes over whether to tell his associate and friend (Kevin James) that he saw the man's wife out with another guy.

programme.title: Smoking Tigers
programme.desc: Lonely 16-year-old Korean American Hayoung tries to hide her problematic family and lower-income background from her new wealthy friends.

programme.title: Brian Banks
programme.desc: The true story of Brian Banks, a high school football player who faces prison for a crime he didn't commit. Years later, with the support of the California Innocence Project, Banks fights to reclaim his life and fulfill his dreams of NFL stardom.

programme.title: Mid90s
programme.desc: In the 1990s Los Angeles, a 13-year-old spends his summer navigating between a troubled home life and a crew of new friends he meets at a skate shop.

programme.title: Inconceivable
programme.desc: Angela develops a friendship with a mysterious woman named Katie and offers her a job as a live-in nanny. The natural bond soon turns into a dangerous obsession as Katie becomes overly attached to the family's young daughter.

programme.title: The Transporter Refueled
programme.desc: Former special-operations mercenary Frank Martin (Ed Skrein) utilizes his covert skills when a femme fatale (Loan Chabanol) uses him as a pawn in her vengeful scheme against the human trafficker (Camille Delamarre) who victimized her years earlier.

programme.title: Men
programme.desc: Harper retreats to the countryside to be alone in the wake of a tragedy, but her unease at the town's leering and uncannily similar men grows into a fully fledged nightmare as her arrival awakens something primal in the forest.

programme.title: Enter Nowhere
programme.desc: Three strangers arrive one at a time in a remote cabin, and learn they have been brought together for a reason.

programme.title: Robin Hood
programme.desc: In twelfth-century England, Robin Longstride and his band of marauders confront corruption in a local village and lead an uprising against the crown that will forever alter the balance of power.

programme.title: Tomb Raider
programme.desc: Hoping to solve the mystery of her father's disappearance, young Lara Croft embarks on a perilous journey to his last-known destination -- a fabled tomb on a mythical island that might be somewhere off the coast of Japan.

programme.title: Beetlejuice Beetlejuice
programme.desc: Still haunted by Beetlejuice, Lydia's life gets turned upside down when her daughter discovers a portal to the afterlife. When someone says Beetlejuice's name three times, the mischievous demon returns to unleash his very own brand of mayhem.

programme.title: Papillon
programme.desc: The epic story of Henri Papillon Charrière, framed for murder and condemned to life in the notorious penal colony on Devil's Island. Determined to regain his freedom, Papillon forms an alliance with counterfeiter Louis Dega to finance his escape.

programme.title: Nerve
programme.desc: Partnered with a mysterious stranger (Dave Franco), a high school senior (Emma Roberts) joins a popular online game that dares players to perform increasingly dangerous stunts.

programme.title: Hidden Figures
programme.desc: NASA mathematicians Katherine Johnson, Dorothy Vaughan and Mary Jackson cross gender and race lines to help launch astronaut John Glenn into outer space.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Caped Crusader (Michael Keaton) saves dismal Gotham City and gorgeous Vicki Vale (Kim Basinger) from the freaky Joker (Jack Nicholson).

programme.title: Batman & Robin
programme.desc: Batgirl joins the caped crusaders (George Clooney, Chris O'Donnell) to stop Mr. Freeze (Arnold Schwarzenegger) and Poison Ivy from wreaking revenge upon the world.

programme.title: Batman Forever
programme.desc: The Caped Crusader (Val Kilmer) woos a criminal psychologist, takes on a sidekick and battles Two-Face (Tommy Lee Jones) and the Riddler (Jim Carrey).

programme.desc: The father of an intrepid youngster (Quvenzhané Wallis) prepares her for the end of the world, when melting ice caps release fearsome beasts, called aurochs, and rising floodwaters threaten to engulf their Delta home.

programme.desc: After the freighter they're on sinks in a storm, a teenager (Suraj Sharma) and a Bengal tiger wind up on a small lifeboat and must learn to trust each other to survive.

programme.desc: Magically transported to a secret realm, a teenage girl (Amanda Seyfried) joins an ongoing battle between the forces of good, which keep the natural world vital, and the forces of evil, which want to destroy it.

programme.title: Enter Nowhere
programme.desc: Three strangers arrive one at a time in a remote cabin, and learn they have been brought together for a reason.

programme.title: Robin Hood
programme.desc: In twelfth-century England, Robin Longstride and his band of marauders confront corruption in a local village and lead an uprising against the crown that will forever alter the balance of power.

programme.title: Tomb Raider
programme.desc: Hoping to solve the mystery of her father's disappearance, young Lara Croft embarks on a perilous journey to his last-known destination -- a fabled tomb on a mythical island that might be somewhere off the coast of Japan.

programme.title: Beetlejuice Beetlejuice
programme.desc: Still haunted by Beetlejuice, Lydia's life gets turned upside down when her daughter discovers a portal to the afterlife. When someone says Beetlejuice's name three times, the mischievous demon returns to unleash his very own brand of mayhem.

programme.title: Papillon
programme.desc: The epic story of Henri Papillon Charrière, framed for murder and condemned to life in the notorious penal colony on Devil's Island. Determined to regain his freedom, Papillon forms an alliance with counterfeiter Louis Dega to finance his escape.

programme.title: Nerve
programme.desc: Partnered with a mysterious stranger (Dave Franco), a high school senior (Emma Roberts) joins a popular online game that dares players to perform increasingly dangerous stunts.

programme.title: Hidden Figures
programme.desc: NASA mathematicians Katherine Johnson, Dorothy Vaughan and Mary Jackson cross gender and race lines to help launch astronaut John Glenn into outer space.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Caped Crusader (Michael Keaton) saves dismal Gotham City and gorgeous Vicki Vale (Kim Basinger) from the freaky Joker (Jack Nicholson).

programme.title: Batman Returns
programme.desc: The Caped Crusader (Michael Keaton) clashes with Catwoman (Michelle Pfeiffer) and saves gloomy Gotham City from the foul Penguin's (Danny DeVito) plot.

programme.title: Batman & Robin
programme.desc: Batgirl joins the caped crusaders (George Clooney, Chris O'Donnell) to stop Mr. Freeze (Arnold Schwarzenegger) and Poison Ivy from wreaking revenge upon the world.

programme.title: Batman Forever
programme.desc: The Caped Crusader (Val Kilmer) woos a criminal psychologist, takes on a sidekick and battles Two-Face (Tommy Lee Jones) and the Riddler (Jim Carrey).

programme.title: Beasts of the Southern Wild
programme.desc: The father of an intrepid youngster (Quvenzhané Wallis) prepares her for the end of the world, when melting ice caps release fearsome beasts, called aurochs, and rising floodwaters threaten to engulf their Delta home.

programme.title: Life of Pi
programme.desc: After the freighter they're on sinks in a storm, a teenager (Suraj Sharma) and a Bengal tiger wind up on a small lifeboat and must learn to trust each other to survive.

programme.title: Epic
programme.desc: Magically transported to a secret realm, a teenage girl (Amanda Seyfried) joins an ongoing battle between the forces of good, which keep the natural world vital, and the forces of evil, which want to destroy it.

programme.title: Arctic
programme.desc: A man stranded in the Arctic after an airplane crash must decide whether to remain in the relative safety of his makeshift camp or to embark on a deadly trek through the unknown in hopes of making it out alive.

programme.title: X-Men: First Class
programme.desc: Charles Xavier and Erik Lehnsherr work with other mutants to prevent a nuclear nightmare, but a situation soon tears the close friends apart.

programme.title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
programme.desc: Godzilla and the almighty Kong face a colossal threat hidden deep within the planet, challenging their very existence and the survival of the human race.

programme.title: Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri
programme.desc: After a 50-year-old woman's (Frances McDormand) daughter is murdered, she confronts the police (Caleb Landry Jones, Kerry Condon) in her town, using the billboards on the outskirts of town to begin a smear campaign against them.

programme.title: Spring Breakers
programme.desc: Four college friends (Vanessa Hudgens, Selena Gomez, Ashley Benson, Rachel Korine) are arrested after robbing a restaurant to fund their spring-break trip. They land in more trouble when a drug and arms dealer bails them out to do some dirty work.

programme.title: Get Him to the Greek
programme.desc: A record-company employee (Jonah Hill) has just a few days to get a boozy British rock star (Russell Brand) to Hollywood for a big comeback concert.

programme.title: Shazam!
programme.desc: Billy Batson is a streetwise 14-year-old who can magically transform into the adult superhero Shazam simply by shouting out one word. His newfound powers soon get put to the test when he squares off against the evil Dr. Thaddeus Sivana.

programme.title: Shazam! Fury of the Gods
programme.desc: When a vengeful trio of ancient gods arrives on Earth in search of the magic stolen from them long ago, Shazam and his allies get thrust into a battle for their superpowers, their lives and the fate of the world.

programme.title: DC League of Super-Pets
programme.desc: Krypto the Super-Dog must convince a ragtag group of animals to master their own newfound powers to help him save Superman and the rest of the Justice League.

programme.title: Wonka
programme.desc: Armed with nothing but a hatful of dreams, young chocolatier Willy Wonka manages to change the world, one delectable bite at a time.

programme.title: Lady Bird
programme.desc: A teenager (Saoirse Ronan) navigates a loving but turbulent relationship with her strong-willed mother (Laurie Metcalf) over the course of an eventful and poignant senior year of high school.

programme.title: Colette
programme.desc: After moving to Paris, author Sidonie-Gabrielle Colette agrees to ghostwrite a semi-autobiographical novel for her husband. Its success soon inspires her to fight for creative ownership and overcome the societal constraints of the early 20th century.

programme.title: Adult Best Friends
programme.desc: Katie takes her best friend on a nostalgic trip to their hometown to tell her she's getting married. Their journey soon takes some unexpected turns courtesy of a bizarre rental homeowner, a bachelor party, and a few potential love interests.

programme.title: Due Date
programme.desc: Desperate to reach his pregnant wife (Michelle Monaghan), a high-strung architect (Robert Downey Jr.) takes a road trip home with an annoying stranger (Zach Galifianakis).

programme.title: Joker
programme.desc: Isolated, bullied and disregarded by society, failed comedian Arthur Fleck begins a slow descent into madness as he transforms into the criminal mastermind known as the Joker.

programme.title: Wedding Crashers

programme.title: Shot Caller
programme.desc: Recently released from prison, a gang member finds himself forced by his leaders to orchestrate a major crime with a rival gang.
